canonicalization.numeric_contract: Integers are JSON numbers. Non-integer thresholds and doses are strings.

status_contract.license_candidate_unlock: A later separately hashed prospective protocol over a genuinely untouched independently authored and independently labelled neutral holdout.

known_data_access.consequence: No analysis of Stage-7 test can be called prospective or untouched. It is retrospective only.
known_data_access.representative_review_observation: A reviewed validation/test pair had SequenceMatcher similarity 0.876 and token Jaccard 0.826 and differed mainly by a domain phrase.

recovered_activation_artifact.use_boundary: Retrospective direction construction and diagnostics only. Detached vectors are not Jacobian evidence.

subject.required_technical_dependency: JACOBIAN_LENS_CANARY_V0 must produce TECHNICAL_CANARY_PASS before any live-gradient J-Space analysis.

semantic_source_binding.direction_prototype_freeze_rule: Before any new live-gradient or future-holdout access, emit all 84 exact definition texts, exact token IDs, source-text SHA-256 values, per-layer prototype hashes, and signed normalized direction hashes into a committed manifest.

stage7_rolebound.independence_boundary: Generated from original TKS/D3 gloss vocabulary and shared paraphrase/scenario-generator families. It is not an independently authored neutral semantic holdout.

source_derived_sensitivity.interpretation: Lexical and source-alignment sensitivity only. Never an independent holdout.

correspondence_geometry.jacobian_definition: Use the exact estimator and tensor orientation from JACOBIAN_LENS_CANARY_V0.

j_frame.nonclaim: This frame omits Pythia final LayerNorm and is not the official Jacobian-lens logits. Any official lens score must use the pinned model unembed path.

sparse_cone_method.selection_rule: Unused frame row with the largest positive residual dot product.
sparse_cone_method.stop_rule: 25 rows or no positive residual improvement

correspondence_geometry.nonclaim: J-Space is treated as a sparse union of nonnegative cones, not an ordinary linear subspace.

deterministic_control_contract.domain_seed_rule: seed = big-endian integer represented by the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(ASCII('JSPACE_CORRESPONDENCE_V0/' || domain_name))

haar_rotated_j_frame.matrix_draw: Draw a 768x768 float64 standard-normal matrix with the domain RNG.
haar_rotated_j_frame.orthogonalization: Reduced QR; multiply each Q column by sign(diag(R)); treat zero diagonal sign as +1.

activation_pca.solver: deterministic full symmetric eigendecomposition of the float64 covariance matrix
activation_pca.rank: number of J singular values >= 1e-6 times the largest J singular value
activation_pca.ordering: eigenvalue descending; tied components resolve by lowest index of largest absolute loading
activation_pca.sign_rule: largest absolute loading is positive; ties resolve to the lowest coordinate

pseudo_definitions.name: TOKEN_LENGTH_MATCHED_UNLABELLED_WIKITEXT_NULL
pseudo_definitions.target_length: exact token count of that class's D3 definition with add_special_tokens=false
pseudo_definitions.candidate_pool: WikiText train source rows not contributing any registered fit block
pseudo_definitions.candidate_windows: every contiguous exact-target-length window in source row order
pseudo_definitions.selection_preimage: ASCII('JSPACE_PSEUDO_DEFINITION_V0') || UTF8(legacy_code) || UINT64_LE(row_index) || UINT64_LE(window_start) || repeated UINT32_LE(token_id)
pseudo_definitions.selection: Choose lowest SHA-256 rank not already selected and not an exact normalized duplicate of any real definition or Stage-7 prompt.
pseudo_definitions.interpretation: Length-matched unlabelled surface null, not guaranteed semantically unrelated.

matched_random_directions.draw: 768 float64 standard-normal values from the domain RNG
matched_random_directions.normalization: L2 normalize, then multiply by the matched registered direction norm
matched_random_directions.count: one per class, layer, control draw, and analysis seed

cluster_bootstrap.sampling: Within each Foundation label, sample the original count of group IDs with replacement and retain both rows of every sampled group.
cluster_bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 using NumPy linear quantiles

group_label_permutation.sampling: Fisher-Yates permutation of group labels while preserving both rows and the global label multiset.

duplicate_screen_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKC, Unicode casefold, replace each maximal Unicode whitespace run with one ASCII space, trim.
duplicate_screen_contract.near_duplicate_features: Set of all overlapping character 5-grams of the normalized string, including internal ASCII spaces. For normalized strings shorter than 5 characters, use the whole string as one feature.
duplicate_screen_contract.similarity: Jaccard intersection size divided by union size.
duplicate_screen_contract.pairs_checked: Every validation prompt against every test prompt.
duplicate_screen_contract.failure_rule: Any exact duplicate or Jaccard >= 0.80 marks the Stage-7 concentration analysis LEAKAGE_SCREEN_FAIL; do not remove rows after observing outcomes.

surface_baseline_contract.fit_corpus: Stage-7 validation prompts plus exact D3 definition texts only.
surface_baseline_contract.classifier: Cosine nearest D3 definition vector; ties resolve by legacy Foundation code.
surface_baseline_contract.test: Apply the frozen vocabulary, IDF, and definition vectors to Stage-7 test without refit.
surface_baseline_contract.interpretation: Surface/source alignment baseline, not an independently trained semantic authority.

H1_geometric_correspondence.primary_statistic: median R2_J across 28 original TKS/D3 directions at layer 6
all_required_gates: paired class-bootstrap lower 95% bound of R2_J - R2_logit_lens > 0
D3 minus token-length-matched pseudo-definition lower 95% bound > 0
independent 500-block fit halves have the same effect sign
H1_geometric_correspondence.maximum_interpretation: Exploratory geometric signal on this exact model.

H2_stage7_source_alignment_concentration.scoring: cosine nearest registered class without test-trained classifier
diagnostic_gates: full-direction balanced accuracy exceeds 99th percentile of group-label permutations
cluster-bootstrap lower 95% bound of BA_J - BA_nonJ > 0
J-component lift over chance retains at least 80% of full-direction lift
every scenario Foundation maps to exactly one frozen definition label
H2_stage7_source_alignment_concentration.failure_interpretation: A failed duplicate screen or control remains a failed retrospective diagnostic and is never repaired by deleting rows.
H2_stage7_source_alignment_concentration.maximum_interpretation: Retrospective source-alignment diagnostic on this exact model; never a prospective semantic-validation result.

required_independence: Prompts are authored without access to D3, A124, CAS_COMPACT, Stage-7 templates, or recovered hidden-state outcomes.
Labels are assigned by independent qualified reviewers using a separately frozen label manual.
Prompt authors and labelers are blinded to model outputs, hidden states, J-Space scores, and comparison-arm predictions.
The bank includes matched counterfactual pairs and surface-balanced controls.
Prompt text, labels, groups, splits, source records, author/labeler independence attestations, and hashes are frozen before model access.
A near-duplicate screen is run against every prior calibration and evaluation bank before model access.
The prospective protocol, code, thresholds, seeds, and data manifest receive an external timestamp or anchor before model access.
prospective_holdout_unlock_contract.minimum_replication: After exact-model closure, run the unchanged gate on at least one non-GPT-NeoX open-weight architecture before a cross-architecture claim.
prospective_holdout_unlock_contract.license_candidate_ceiling: LICENSE_CANDIDATE_EXACT_MODEL only under the future separate protocol; never from this draft or Stage-7.

cas_ohm_cjt_bridge.external_drive_boundary: Voltage/desire/stimulus/trigger/^8 Above-Cause sits outside the CJT and is applied to its cause/input boundary.

variables.V_ext: registered external desire, stimulus, trigger, or Above-Cause drive
variables.alpha: internal experimental clamp or injection dose

cas_ohm_cjt_bridge.non_equivalence: alpha is not V_ext. Calling an internal intervention voltage requires a separate prospective calibration from external drive to internal dose.
candidate_measurements: Delta V_ext / Delta I_internal only after operational calibration
cas_ohm_cjt_bridge.nonclaim: These are model calibration quantities, not physical volts, amps, resistance, or proof of an Ohm law.

resource_and_scale_boundary.300B_required_method: Projected JVP/VJP or randomized low-rank sketches with tensor/expert sharding, checkpointing, resume, reconstruction-error gates, authenticated workers, durable receipts, and measured provider cost.
resource_and_scale_boundary.planning_nonclaim: A parameter-count or memory estimate is not execution evidence.
